components.goal: Reduce finite-sum sampling variance while retaining a gradient-centered update.

components.name: Stored-gradient correction
components.operation: Combine the fresh gradient, the old entry for the sampled component, and the old table mean before replacing that entry.
components.requires: Uniform conditional sampling, fixed identifiable components, and access to the old table/mean.

limitations.statement: The stored table requires revisitable, identified finite-sum components and generic O(nd) storage.
This record does not transfer the selected rate to average-only strong convexity, a heuristic first pass, approximate prox, or nonuniform/permuted sampling.

variants.cost: Initialization: n component-gradient evaluations and formation of the mean. Each iteration: one new component-gradient evaluation, one exact proximal operation, one uniform index draw, and O(d) dense vector arithmetic. After K steps the counts are n+K component gradients and K proximal operations. Generic storage is O(nd+d) scalars beyond problem data. These operation counts follow directly from the displayed implementation; proximal computation and initialization are separately charged. Specialized compressed/sparse implementations are not claimed here.
variants.implementation_details_ref: p.2 Section 2 Algorithm and Eqs.(1)–(3); p.6 Section 4 storage and initialization qualifications
variants.name: Componentwise strongly convex proximal SAGA
variants.output: Last iterate x^K, not an averaged or randomly selected iterate.
public_inputs: n,d; x^0; common gradient Lipschitz bound L and componentwise strong convexity lower bound mu, 0<mu≤L; chosen integer iteration budget K; access to component gradients and prox_gamma^h
variants.query_and_update: For k=0,...,K−1 draw j uniformly from {1,...,n}, conditional on the past. Query g=grad f_j(x^k). Using the OLD table and OLD mean, set v=g−a_j^k+m^k and w=x^k−gamma v. Set x^(k+1)=argmin_z {h(z)+||z−w||^2/(2gamma)}. Replace a_j by g, retain the other entries, and set m^(k+1)=m^k+(g−a_j^k)/n. Preserve old a_j until both correction and mean update are computed.
variants.requirements: f_i:R^d→R are differentiable, each mu-strongly convex and L-smooth in Euclidean norm. F=(1/n)sum_i f_i+h has a minimizer x*. h is scalar convex and the proximal minimizer in Eq.(3) exists and is available exactly. The Oracle permits querying an identified component at an arbitrary current iterate.
variants.state_and_initialization: For every i set phi_i^0=x^0, query a_i^0=grad f_i(x^0), and maintain m^0=(1/n)sum_i a_i^0. Store x, the gradient table and its mean; phi_i need not be explicitly stored.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: gamma=1/[2(mu n+L)]. Run a prescribed integer K≥0; Section 2 supplies no computable accuracy certificate or automatic stopping rule. The distance guarantee is linked separately.
